title: PII in logs — runtime grep and static rule
notes: pii_hits_in_logs greps only lines matching src/lib/logger.ts's own output format (never test-runner chatter or assertion text) for cuid-shaped ids collected from test-file `id:`/`studentId:` literals plus phone/email patterns — the runtime backstop for what the static ESLint selector can't see (interpolated strings, spreads, caught-error messages). pii_eslint_violations isolates the four PII selectors already in eslint.config.mjs's `restrictedSyntaxEverywhere` (2026-08-20 sweep, PR #164) from that array's unrelated dark-mode rgba() guards, by filtering on their shared 'No student identifier ...' message prefix. Reads $BENCH_TEST_LOG when set; otherwise spawns `npm test` itself with a 240s bound and captures its output. Both measured 0 on 2026-09-05.
